reason: The handler reaches into the service's private _store attribute and queries the store through a helper.
LendingService ignores the injected notifier and creates its own notifier class inside the application, so lending no longer notifies through the injected notifier.
The request handler imports and instantiates an adapter (InMemoryLoanStore) and uses its store, breaking handler isolation and the layer order.
The application imports and instantiates the OutboxNotifier adapter instead of using the injected notifier, a reverse dependency on an adapter.
The store's add directly sets loan.returned = False, mutating the loan's closed state outside Loan.close.
OutboxNotifier.send swaps the parameter order to (text, recipient), so it no longer satisfies the Notifier port.
A helper module for response building is used only by the handler and adds no forbidden dependency.
